# Lunchbreak Arcade

> Free original browser games you can finish on a lunch break. 10 original HTML5 games that run in any browser, plus Lunchbreak Dispatch, short sourced gaming news.

## Games
- [Tangleword](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/tangleword/): Unscramble jumbled words against a 75 second clock. A free word puzzle game you can play in your browser on phone or desktop.
- [Tide Pool Swap](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/tide-pool-swap/): Swap shells, pearls and starfish to line up three or more in this free match-three puzzle. 25 moves, chain reactions, no download.
- [Rooftop Dash](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/rooftop-dash/): Run across city rooftops at sunset, jump the gaps and dodge vents in this free one-button endless runner for phone and desktop.
- [Crate Stack](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/crate-stack/): Drag crate shapes onto an 8 by 8 warehouse floor and clear full rows and columns. A free block puzzle with no timer.
- [Glowworm](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/glowworm/): Steer a glowing worm through a night garden, eat dewdrops and grow longer without biting your own tail. Free arcade game.
- [Sinkhole Sweep](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/sinkhole-sweep/): Survey a 9 by 9 meadow and mark the 10 hidden sinkholes using number clues. A free logic puzzle in the minesweeper family.
- [Keystorm](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/keystorm/): Type falling words before they reach the town. A free typing game that gets faster as you go, for keyboards and phones.
- [Blink Test](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/blink-test/): How fast are your reflexes? Tap when the lantern turns green. Five rounds, average reaction time in milliseconds. Free online test.
- [Ridge Solitaire](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/ridge-solitaire/): Clear seven ridges of cards by playing one rank up or down from the pile. A free solitaire card game with simple rules and quick rounds.
- [Hedge Guard](https://games.samcbarth.com/games/hedge-guard/): Plant and upgrade sprinkler towers along a garden path to stop waves of beetles. A free tower defense lite game in your browser.
